description: This file defines the HTMLPurifier_TokenFactory class, which is responsible for creating various token objects used in HTML parsing. It implements an optimization by cloning prototype token objects instead of instantiating new ones, thus improving performance during token generation.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_TokenFactory
classes.description: Factory class for generating HTMLToken objects efficiently by cloning prototypes.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes prototype token objects for start, end, empty, text, and comment tokens.

methods.name: createStart
methods.description: Creates a new HTMLPurifier_Token_Start object by cloning the start prototype and initializing it with provided name and attributes.

methods.name: createEnd
methods.description: Creates a new HTMLPurifier_Token_End object by cloning the end prototype and initializing it with provided name.

methods.name: createEmpty
methods.description: Creates a new HTMLPurifier_Token_Empty object by cloning the empty prototype and initializing it with provided name and attributes.

methods.name: createText
methods.description: Creates a new HTMLPurifier_Token_Text object by cloning the text prototype and setting its data.

methods.name: createComment
methods.description: Creates a new HTMLPurifier_Token_Comment object by cloning the comment prototype and setting its data.
